title: Data and evaluation trust
objective: Remove duplicate and scenario leakage, preserve label uncertainty, and make every result reproducible.
entry_criteria: Raw videos and source labels available locally.
exit_criteria: Hash audit, pair-safe folds, deterministic manifests, ONNX parity, and baseline scorecard exist.

title: Out-of-fold truth layer
objective: Estimate model quality and threshold without relying on one eight-video holdout.
entry_criteria: C0 complete and all scenario groups have fold IDs.
exit_criteria: Five nested OOF runs with inner-fold threshold calibration, bootstrap intervals, and error clusters recorded.

title: Temporal anomaly learning
objective: Learn from complete-video snippet bags and localize sparse abnormal events.
exit_criteria: MIL beats v3 on OOF AUROC or timestamp MAE without violating latency and false-positive gates.

title: Active human feedback
objective: Turn reviewer decisions and recurring errors into the highest-value new training examples.
entry_criteria: Review UI stores objective observation separately from rule interpretation.
exit_criteria: At least two review/retrain cycles show positive confidence-adjusted reward.

title: Interpretable detector fusion
objective: Add people, zones, doors, and table-state detectors only where error analysis supports them.
entry_criteria: Confirmed rule families and annotated zones or objects exist.
exit_criteria: Rule-level evidence is measurable on contrastive pairs and improves the global reward.
